hh2_dad.text: Shush, the baby is asleep. Well, the cat is. It is the same thing.
If something is lush here, it is great. If you are twp, you are a bit daft. Both useful words.
The ferries are huge, but the ships in the old days carried the post. My great-grandad sorted it at the station.

then.text: Mind, it is hot. Do not drink it all at once, you will miss the ferry.

else.text: Fancy a cuppa while you are here? There is always one on the go.
